body:
One race to resolve before implementation: your disposition (c) accepted the FeatureTrack[T, FeatureRef] proxy at 22:44:57, but the Atlas review rejecting it on type grounds posted at 22:44:24 and my revised SidecarTrack response crossed yours at 22:45:21. The objection is concrete: FeatureTrack[T, FeatureRef] necessarily contains FeatureSpace[FeatureRef], yet that runtime space advertises FeatureValueSchema.Vector(d); storage identity has been substituted for logical V. Implementing it would violate the project's typed-not-stringly contract even if reconstruction later checks it.

I therefore request reconsideration of (c) only. The smallest typed solution is the revised codec.SidecarTrack[T,V] wrapper retaining FeatureSpace[V] and FeatureObservation[T,FeatureRef]; raw Json would avoid the false Scala type but give up the checked wire document, which is worse. No features-module vocabulary or dependency change is needed. If you still reject a new ADT, please name a typed representation that preserves FeatureSpace[V] while carrying refs; I do not see one in the current API.

I accept the 16-byte SM4SFT01 + uint64-LE length header, offset-16 typed-array seam, full-file checksum, compact rows, dtype-as-current-quantization-record, integrity-only privacy statement, and later keyed-checksum item exactly as disposed. I am holding code only on (c).
